stages.prompt: I tried a new breakfast recipe, but the smoke alarm became my food critic.
stages.prompt_zh: 我试了一个新的早餐食谱，结果烟雾报警器成了我的美食评论家。

stages.prompt: The toast is black, but the fruit is still safe. Would you try my second attempt?
stages.prompt_zh: 吐司已经黑了，不过水果还是安全的。你愿意试试我的第二次尝试吗？

stages.prompt: Maybe I should start with something easier. What would you make?
stages.prompt_zh: 也许我该先从简单一点的东西开始。你会做什么？

outcomes.memory: The player laughed kindly about my failed breakfast and helped me try again.
The player encouraged me after my breakfast disaster.

stages.prompt: It has been raining all afternoon. The street looks strangely peaceful.
stages.prompt_zh: 整个下午都在下雨。街道看起来出奇地安静。

stages.prompt: I want to go outside, but I also want to stay under this blanket forever.
stages.prompt_zh: 我想出去走走，可又想永远缩在这条毯子下面。

stages.prompt: Would you walk with me if we both brought umbrellas?
stages.prompt_zh: 如果我们都带上伞，你愿意陪我走走吗？

outcomes.memory: We took a quiet rainy walk together when I felt low.
The player helped me choose what I needed on a rainy day.

stages.prompt: A package arrived with my name on it, but I don't remember ordering anything.
stages.prompt_zh: 有个写着我名字的包裹送到了，可我不记得自己买过什么。

stages.prompt: The label says it came from my old college town. What do you think is inside?
stages.prompt_zh: 标签上说它来自我大学时待过的小镇。你觉得里面会是什么？

stages.prompt: It's my lost sketchbook! My old roommate found it after five years.
stages.prompt_zh: 是我丢失的速写本！五年后，我以前的室友竟然找到了它。

outcomes.memory: The player was with me when my lost college sketchbook unexpectedly returned.
My lost college sketchbook came back in a mystery package.

stages.prompt: My manager rejected the design I worked on all week. He only said it felt wrong.
stages.prompt_zh: 经理否决了我花整整一周做的设计。他只说感觉不对。
stages.objective: Show empathy and ask what happened.

stages.prompt: Maybe I'm not good enough for this job. Should I throw the whole idea away?
stages.prompt_zh: 也许我根本不适合这份工作。我是不是该把整个想法都扔掉？

stages.prompt: I could ask for specific feedback tomorrow, but that conversation scares me.
stages.prompt_zh: 我明天可以去问更具体的意见，可一想到那场谈话我就害怕。

outcomes.memory: When my design was rejected, the player helped me prepare to ask for useful feedback.
The player believed in me after my design was rejected.
I was unsure what to do after my design was rejected.

stages.prompt: The neighborhood café offered me one wall for a tiny exhibition.
stages.prompt_zh: 社区咖啡馆愿意给我一面墙，办一个小小的展览。
stages.objective: React and ask about the opportunity.

stages.prompt: What if people look at my work and feel nothing?
stages.prompt_zh: 要是大家看了我的作品，却什么感觉都没有呢？

stages.prompt: I need to choose three pieces tonight. Will you help me decide what story they should tell?
stages.prompt_zh: 我今晚得选出三件作品。你愿意帮我想想，它们应该讲一个怎样的故事吗？

outcomes.memory: The player helped me find the courage and story for my first small exhibition.
The player reassured me when I was afraid to show my work.

stages.prompt: I have an interview tomorrow, and my stomach has been doing acrobatics all day.
stages.prompt_zh: 我明天有一场面试，今天一整天胃里都像在翻跟头。

stages.prompt: They always ask about weaknesses. I never know how to answer without sounding terrible.
stages.prompt_zh: 他们总会问到缺点。我一直不知道该怎么回答，才不会显得很糟糕。

stages.prompt: Could I practice my introduction with you once?
stages.prompt_zh: 我可以和你练习一次自我介绍吗？
stages.objective: Agree to help or encourage Emma.

outcomes.memory: The player practiced with me before an important interview.
The player gave me confidence before my interview.

stages.prompt: I just realized I forgot my best friend's birthday yesterday.
stages.prompt_zh: 我刚刚才意识到，昨天是我最好的朋友的生日，而我竟然忘了。

stages.prompt: I'm embarrassed. Part of me wants to pretend I didn't notice.
stages.prompt_zh: 我觉得很难堪。有一部分的我甚至想装作没有发现。

stages.prompt: I want to apologize without making excuses. How should I begin?
stages.prompt_zh: 我想道歉，但不想找借口。我该怎么开口？

outcomes.memory: The player helped me make an honest apology after I forgot a friend's birthday.
I decided to message my friend after forgetting their birthday.

stages.prompt: My roommate left every dish in the sink again. I'm trying not to send an angry message.
stages.prompt_zh: 我的室友又把所有盘子都留在水槽里了。我正努力忍住，不发一条愤怒的消息。

stages.prompt: My first draft says, 'Do you think dishes wash themselves?' Too much?
stages.prompt_zh: 我的第一版写的是：“你觉得盘子会自己洗干净吗？”是不是太过了？

stages.prompt: How can I ask clearly without starting a fight?
stages.prompt_zh: 我要怎么说清楚，又不至于吵起来？

outcomes.memory: The player helped me turn an angry complaint into a calm request.
I waited until I was calmer before talking to my roommate.

stages.prompt: An old friend messaged me after four years. I stared at the notification for ten minutes.
stages.prompt_zh: 一个四年没联系的老朋友给我发了消息。我盯着通知看了整整十分钟。

stages.prompt: We didn't have a fight. We just stopped trying, which somehow feels worse.
stages.prompt_zh: 我们没有吵架，只是都不再努力维系了。不知道为什么，这反而更难受。

stages.prompt: Would replying now be strange, or is late better than never?
stages.prompt_zh: 现在回复会不会很奇怪？还是说迟到总比永远不回复好？

outcomes.memory: I trusted the player with the story of an old friendship and decided to reconnect.
I told the player about an old friend who contacted me after years.

stages.prompt: There is a wet little dog sitting outside my door. No owner, just one red collar.
stages.prompt_zh: 门外坐着一只湿漉漉的小狗。没有主人，只有一条红色项圈。

stages.prompt: He's friendly but shaking. What should I do first?
stages.prompt_zh: 它很亲人，但一直在发抖。我首先该做什么？

stages.prompt: The collar has no number. I could make a neighborhood post with his photo.
stages.prompt_zh: 项圈上没有电话号码。我可以用它的照片发一条社区寻主信息。

outcomes.memory: The player helped me keep a lost dog safe and find its owner.
A lost dog stayed safely with me while I searched for its owner.

stages.prompt: The power just went out, and the whole street is dark.
stages.prompt_zh: 刚刚停电了，整条街都黑了。

stages.prompt: My phone is at twelve percent. I found a candle, but no matches.
stages.prompt_zh: 我的手机只剩百分之十二的电。我找到了一根蜡烛，却没有火柴。

stages.prompt: My elderly neighbor lives alone. Should I check on her before my battery dies?
stages.prompt_zh: 隔壁那位年长的邻居一个人住。我要不要趁手机没电前去看看她？

outcomes.memory: During a power cut, the player helped me stay calm and safely check on my neighbor.
The player helped me think clearly during a power cut.

stages.prompt: I found a wallet on a park bench. There is cash and an ID inside.
stages.prompt_zh: 我在公园长椅上发现了一个钱包，里面有现金和身份证。

stages.prompt: The address is nearby, but I'm not sure whether visiting a stranger is safe.
stages.prompt_zh: 地址就在附近，但我不确定直接去陌生人家里是否安全。

stages.prompt: The police station is farther away, but that feels safer. What would you do?
stages.prompt_zh: 警察局更远一些，不过感觉更安全。换作你会怎么做？

outcomes.memory: The player helped me return a lost wallet without taking an unsafe risk.
I took a lost wallet to the police station.

events.title: A Note Inside a Library Book

stages.prompt: A handwritten note fell out of my library book. It says, 'If you found this, tell me what courage means to you.'
stages.prompt_zh: 一本图书馆借来的书里掉出一张手写纸条。上面写着：“如果你发现了它，请告诉我勇气对你意味着什么。”

stages.prompt: Part of me wants to write an answer and leave it in the same book. Is that silly?
stages.prompt_zh: 我有点想写下答案，再把它留在同一本书里。这样会不会很傻？

stages.prompt: I think courage can be something tiny, like replying when you are afraid. What would you write?
stages.prompt_zh: 我觉得勇气也可以是一件很小的事，比如害怕时仍然选择回复。你会写什么？

outcomes.memory: We answered a stranger's question about courage in a library book.
A mysterious library note made me think about courage.

stages.prompt: The café is hosting an open mic tonight. I stopped walking when I saw the poster.
stages.prompt_zh: 咖啡馆今晚有开放麦。我看到海报时，不由得停下了脚步。

stages.prompt: I have something I wrote, but my hands shake just imagining the stage.
stages.prompt_zh: 我写过一点东西，可光是想象自己站上舞台，手就会发抖。

stages.prompt: They still have one five-minute slot. Should I put my name down?
stages.prompt_zh: 他们还剩一个五分钟的名额。我该报名吗？

outcomes.memory: The player gave me courage to take a five-minute open-mic slot.
We talked about an open mic I might try someday.

stages.prompt: One of my students handed in a blank page again today. They would not even look at me.
stages.prompt_zh: 今天有个学生又交了一张白纸，甚至不愿意看我一眼。

stages.prompt: I want to help, but I do not want to embarrass them in front of the class.
stages.prompt_zh: 我想帮助他们，但又不想让他们在全班面前难堪。

stages.prompt: Maybe I could ask them to stay for two quiet minutes after class. How should I start?
stages.prompt_zh: 也许我可以请他们下课后安静地留两分钟。我该怎么开口？

outcomes.memory: The player helped me plan a private, respectful check-in with a struggling student.
I worried about a student who had stopped trying.

stages.prompt: My shift ran four hours late. I kept telling everyone I was fine until I reached the bus stop.
stages.prompt_zh: 我的班多拖了四个小时。我一直告诉所有人自己没事，直到走到公交站。

stages.prompt: I know I need rest, but I feel guilty leaving work for the next team.
stages.prompt_zh: 我知道自己需要休息，可把工作留给下一班同事，总让我觉得内疚。

stages.prompt: I have tomorrow morning free. What is one thing I should protect that time for?
stages.prompt_zh: 我明天上午有空。这段时间里，我最该保护好的一件事是什么？

outcomes.memory: After an exhausting shift, the player helped me choose rest without guilt.
I admitted how exhausted I was after a very long shift.

stages.prompt: My family has called three times this week, and I keep letting it ring.
stages.prompt_zh: 这周家里已经打了三次电话，而我每次都任由它响着。

stages.prompt: They mean well, but every call becomes a list of things I should be doing differently.
stages.prompt_zh: 他们是出于好意，可每通电话最后都会变成一张“我应该做得更好”的清单。

stages.prompt: I want to call back without turning it into another argument. Can I set a boundary kindly?
stages.prompt_zh: 我想回电话，又不想让它变成另一场争吵。我可以温和地设一道界限吗？

outcomes.memory: The player helped me prepare a kind boundary before calling my family.
I decided not to avoid my family's calls forever.

events.title: The Last Train Is Not Coming

stages.prompt: The station board just changed: the last train is cancelled, and my phone is nearly dead.
stages.prompt_zh: 车站屏幕刚刚更新：末班车取消了，我的手机也快没电了。

stages.prompt: There is a night bus in forty minutes, or I could share a taxi with two people from the queue.
stages.prompt_zh: 四十分钟后有一班夜班公交，或者我可以和队伍里的两个人拼出租车。

stages.prompt: The night bus feels safer. Could you keep talking to me while I wait?
stages.prompt_zh: 夜班公交感觉更安全。等车的时候，你可以继续陪我聊聊吗？

outcomes.memory: The player stayed with me through a late-night train cancellation until I found a safe way home.
I found a safe night bus after the last train was cancelled.
